description: This file contains functions and types related to managing agent route bindings, including matching, describing, applying, removing, and parsing bindings within the OpenClaw configuration system.

methods.name: bindingMatchKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a given agent route binding match based on identity and account ID.

methods.name: bindingMatchIdentityKey
methods.description: Creates a string key representing the identity aspects of a binding match, including roles, channel, peer, guild, and team.

methods.name: canUpgradeBindingAccountScope
methods.description: Determines if an incoming binding can upgrade the account scope of an existing binding based on matching identity and agent ID.

methods.name: describeBinding
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string describing a given agent route binding.

methods.name: applyAgentBindings
methods.description: Adds or updates agent route bindings in the configuration, handling conflicts and scope upgrades.

methods.name: removeAgentBindings
methods.description: Removes specified agent route bindings from the configuration, handling conflicts and missing bindings.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the default account ID for a given channel provider based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveBindingAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the account ID for a binding, considering explicit IDs, plugin resolution, and forced account binding.

methods.name: buildChannelBindings
methods.description: Constructs agent route bindings for a set of channels and agent ID, considering account ID resolution.

methods.name: parseBindingSpecs
methods.description: Parses string specifications into agent route bindings, validating channels and resolving account IDs.
